changes.title: Worms eye potion
items: Worm's Eye potions bring the camera almost to ground level. Adjust the angle and distance in the Potion lab.

changes.title: Miniature potion
items: Miniature makes the island look like a toy world, with thin little-speaker sound.
Potions now alter existing sounds throughout the trip, fading back to normal as they wear off.

changes.title: Chunky potion
items: Chunky potions turn the world into much bigger pixels. Adjust their size in the Potion lab.

changes.title: Audience potion
items: The Audience potion makes the forest lean towards you and follow your passage, a little late.

changes.title: Heat refraction preview
items: An optional refraction preview adds campfire heat and a short party-spell pressure wave; it stays off unless enabled in the link.

changes.title: Mushroom brewing
items: Find mushrooms in quiet corners of the forest and bring them home to the kitchen baskets.
Throw three mushrooms into the cauldron to brew a potion, disappear into colourful smoke and wake beneath the kitchen.
Potions last ten minutes of game time, fading over the last two minutes. During development, the blackout names the effect and marks unfinished ones Coming soon.
Open Potion lab from the pause page to browse numbered recipes, try effects, adjust their settings and copy them for a trip report.

changes.title: Mushroom generator
items: A mushroom art preview now grows colourful, glowing, individually shaped mushrooms beside the witch for scale.
Adjust mushroom height, cap pointiness and other shape ranges; coloured glowing spots stay apart and clear of the cap edge.
